jtbd: record only durable, evidence-backed lessons that improve future agent decisions without creating memory bloat
description: A proposal-oriented learning procedure that captures durable lessons, chooses one destination, and updates memory or harness artifacts only when the note changes future behavior.
trigger_contexts: the end of meaningful work that revealed a reusable lesson
sessions that exposed a route defect or repeated friction
trace distillation and proposal-oriented memory updates
procedure: Identify whether the lesson is durable and likely to recur.
If it is a fixed bug, check the post-mortem gate: reproduction, root cause, fix, and validation coverage.
Choose exactly one destination for the lesson.
Write the smallest note that changes future behavior.
Include supporting evidence when useful and state validation coverage honestly.
Run validation when a harness artifact changed.
forbidden_behaviors: recording one-off preferences as durable cognition
changing stable instructions without evidence or explicit direction
writing a note that does not change future behavior

bundled_resources.purpose: extend the compact learning procedure with the full post-mortem gate and destination rules
bundled_resources.when: a session reveals a reusable lesson, route defect, or durable pattern

bundled_resources.purpose: shape proposal-oriented memory, skill, and harness updates from finished traces
bundled_resources.when: learning needs to be carried forward as a structured packet rather than a direct memory edit

evaluation_prompts.prompt: A session revealed a recurring harness failure pattern. Capture only the smallest evidence-backed lesson that improves future behavior.

success_criteria: the next agent would make a better decision because of the note
the note is durable and concise
validation is rerun when stable harness artifacts changed
failure_modes: the lesson is still too session-specific
evidence is missing for a durable claim
memory bloat hides the actual lesson
